data.content_ref: inline:The target states 'commitments: (none)' yet its entire argument depends on SRC_007 and SRC_009 being falsificationist commitments that 'failed on the SAME artifact (0c61961a8085)'. This creates a fatal circularity: SRC_001 is itself one of the critics under adjudication in the ritual, so using the verdicts of sibling critics (SRC_007, SRC_009) as premises to justify its own sustained flag is bootstrapping. It offers no independent falsificationist evidence for its own claim — it merely piggybacks on two other channels' outputs, which the ritual cannot accept as self-justifying because those channels are themselves under the same audit. By the problem's standard (§11.3), the sustained flag must rest on each critic's OWN commitment to falsifiability, not on recycled sibling verdicts.
